title: Table 3.8a Maximum overshadowing: adjoining property (percentage of dwelling site area)
notes: from: ch3 table-3.9a (renumbered 3.8a); values checked against Chapter 4 Part 1 p42: R25 and lower 25%, R30-R40 35%, R50-R60 50%. Chapter 4 Part 1 prints only these three rows (no R80+ row, unlike Chapter 3), so an adjoining lot coded R80 or above, or a named code, has no row (NOT_APPLICABLE). Site area is the ground surface at NGL without regard to buildings. Footnote 1: where the development adjoins a grouped dwelling development the limit applies to each grouped dwelling site area excluding common property (the footnote cites 'Figure 3.8.d'; the page header cites 'Table 3.9a', both mis-numbered).

verified.note: Three rows only on the page; no R80+ row. Footnote cites 'Figure 3.8.d'; Figure 3.8b labels cite 'Table 3.9a' (both mis-numbered).
